learner.overview.text: It says early forms leave the original motivation unsettled, but does not explain the essential proposed sound-based mechanism for the character’s current meaning. Add a brief, qualified account that the phonetic construction uses 其 as a sound cue, and that this does not establish the separate whole-graph borrowing of 其 for 期.
